Definition: guiltiness, a fault, the presentation of a sin-offering
BiblicalUsage: 1) guiltiness, guilt, offense, sin, wrong-doing; 1a) doing wrong, committing a trespass or offense; 1b) becoming guilty, guilt; 1c) bringing a guilt-offering
